section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study examining the psychometric properties of the state version of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (SBAS-2). The study found that the SBAS-2 has a one-factor solution, satisfactory convergent validity, incremental validity, and internal consistency, and is sensitive to situational contexts. No specific demographic, sample size, or correlation data are provided in this abstract.
